entity.store/authored/file-reopen.purpose: A new FileStore handle recovers state and exact recorded identity.

entity.store/authored/file-stale-write-p.purpose: A stale recorded write reports the revision conflict and leaves all stored evidence unchanged.

entity.store/authored/imported-boundary-.purpose: Imported materialized state is retained without a fabricated genesis or committed receipt.

entity.store/authored/imported-evidence-.purpose: A future observation in imported evidence publishes no state or reserved record identity.

entity.store/authored/legacy-acquisition.purpose: An absent FileStore acquisition returns an empty source without creating provider files.

entity.store/authored/lineage-decisions-.purpose: The real history verifier reports independent decision heads in digest order.

entity.store/authored/memory-atomic-roll.purpose: A later conflict leaves no prefix of a multi-subject transaction.

entity.store/authored/memory-empty-batch.purpose: An empty atomic batch leaves the store empty.

entity.store/authored/memory-exact-retry.purpose: A complete record's exact retry preserves the newer state and appends no duplicate.

entity.store/authored/memory-global-reco.purpose: A record identity cannot be reused across subjects or decision and observation kinds.

entity.store/authored/memory-stale-write.purpose: A stale recorded write reports the revision conflict and leaves all stored evidence unchanged.

entity.store/authored/migration-dry-run-.purpose: Dry run writes no destination; migration preserves source bytes and creates readable legacy state.

entity.store/authored/migration-invalid-.purpose: An identity/path disagreement is refused before destination publication.

entity.store/authored/projection-scalar-.purpose: Projection keys preserve exact numeric and boolean spellings, resolve nested objects, and omit null or structural keys.

entity.store/authored/recorded-memory-wr.purpose: A duplicate inserted after construction is refused at the writer and reserves no identity.
